topics.name: The Special Education Data Model
topics.description: Special education means instruction, services, or programs specially designed to meet the unique needs of students with eligible disabilities as authorized in the Individuals with Disabilities Act (IDEA).

valueDrivers.name: State IDEA Reporting
valueDrivers.description: Part B and C of Section 618 of the IDEA requires each state to submit data about children with disabilities who receive special education and related services under IDEA.   Data is submitted through Generate to EDFacts files.  PCG is working  with partners EA, AEM, and CCSSO to develop a JSON schema that supports all 86 EdFacts submissions that could serve as the central project of the 23 states funded for collaborative open source work (ScDU).

useCases.title: Federal Reporting
useCases.description: An SEA gathers and submits its EDFacts files to the U.S. Department of Education.

openIssues: Scope, priority, frequency, stakeholders (interested parties), precondition, trigger and the success and failure guarantees are not yet written in the workbook.
Each EDFacts file is its own user goal; should each become a user-goal use case invoked from this summary use case?
Only FS002 lists its data (19 elements); the CEDS links on FS002 are proposed and need review, and the other 82 files have none yet.
Several files (Title I, Title III, assessment, directory) are not IDEA files; should they sit under a broader EDFacts reporting value driver?
